This warning appears when you're using the newer MUI Grid (Grid v2) but still passing the old `item` prop, which is no longer needed. Here's what's going on and how to fix it.

## Why you're seeing this warning

In the rewritten Grid component, the concept of a separate "item" was eliminated. In v2, Grid is always an item—similar to the Flexbox item in CSS—so the item prop is no longer needed. Because the `createGrid` internals (which you see in the stack trace pointing to `@mui/system/esm/Unstable_Grid/createGrid.js`) no longer expect an `item` prop, passing one triggers a deprecation/removal warning.

All grids are considered items without specifying the item prop.

## The fix

Simply remove the `item` (and `zeroMinWidth`) props from your Grid components. The item and zeroMinWidth props have been removed in the updated Grid. You can safely remove them: `-<Grid item zeroMinWidth>` becomes `+<Grid>`.

For example, migrating from the legacy Grid:

```jsx
// Before (legacy Grid)
<Grid item xs={6}>...</Grid>

// After (Grid v2)
<Grid size={6}>...</Grid>
```

Note that in newer versions the breakpoint props also changed to a `size` prop. For example: `import { Grid2 } from '@mui/material'; ... <Grid container size={{ xs: 4, sm: 8, md: 12 }}>`.

## Import considerations

The correct import depends on your MUI version:

- **In older v5 setups**, Grid v2 was imported as: `import Grid from '@mui/material/Unstable_Grid2';`
- **In current versions (v6+)**, the updated Grid is now the standard one. The legacy Grid component is named `GridLegacy` (`import Grid from '@mui/material/GridLegacy';`) while the updated Grid component is simply named `Grid` (`import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid';`).

## Additional notes on the codemod

MUI provides codemods to help automate the migration, but they have limitations. The codemod won't cover StyledGrid (`const StyledGrid = styled(Grid)({...})`) or WrappedGrid (`const WrappedGrid = (props) => <Grid {...props} />`)—you'll need to manually update these components.

**Summary:** The warning is harmless but indicates leftover `item` props from Grid v1/legacy usage. Remove all `item` and `zeroMinWidth` props, and update breakpoint props to the `size` prop, and the warning will disappear.

For full details, refer to the official [MUI Grid v2 upgrade guide](https://mui.com/material-ui/migration/upgrade-to-grid-v2/).

## 1. Console warnings for legacy Grid2 props — `packages/mui-system/src/Grid/createGrid.tsx`

`Grid2` (Material) is built from this shared `createGrid` factory, so the warnings live here and use the factory's `componentName` to produce the correct label. `'MuiGrid2'.replace('Mui', 'MUI ')` → `"MUI Grid2"`, giving the exact spec messages.

- **Once-per-session dedup**: a module-level `Set<string>` (`warnedAboutProps`) backs a `warnOncePerSession` helper — each distinct message is logged via `console.warn` only once for the app's lifetime.
- **`item`** → `'MUI Grid2: The \`item\` prop has been removed and is no longer necessary. You can safely remove it.'`
- **`zeroMinWidth`** → analogous message.
- **Breakpoints** → iterates `theme.breakpoints.keys` (xs, sm, md, lg, xl, plus any custom keys) and warns per key: `'MUI Grid2: The \`{breakpoint}\` prop has been removed. See https://mui.com/material-ui/migration/upgrade-to-grid-v2/ for migration instructions.'`
- Warnings are gated behind `process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production'`.
- The legacy props are also `delete`d from the rest object so they aren't forwarded to the DOM (this notably prevents React's own `console.error` for the camelCase `zeroMinWidth`, which would otherwise pollute tests). Importantly, this only checks **top-level** props — a valid `size={{ xs: 12 }}` object is not affected.

## 2. `replaceMaterialLinks` URL mapping — `docs/src/modules/utils/replaceMarkdownLinks.ts`

Added `migration` to the alternation regex, so `/migration/upgrade-to-grid-v2/` → `/material-ui/migration/upgrade-to-grid-v2/`. The sibling utility in `packages/api-docs-builder/utils/replaceUrl.ts` already mapped `/migration/*` generically, so it handles the new path with no change and no hardcoded reference to the old `migration-grid-v2` path.
